A Warden construct sculpted from clay imbued with Veil-suppressant compounds, designed to absorb and neutralize small Rift breaches. It swells as it consumes leaking Rift energy. Without Warden handlers to purge them, old clay golems have grown bloated and unstable — liable to detonate their stored Rift charge.
## Traits
**Acid Absorption.** Takes no damage from acid, regains HP equal to acid damage.
**Berserk.** 40 HP or fewer: d6, on 6 berserk.
**Immutable Form.** Immune to form-altering effects.
**Magic Resistance.** Advantage on saves against spells.

## Actions
**Multiattack.** Two slam attacks.
**Slam.** +8 to hit, 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning. DC 15 CON save or max HP reduced by damage taken until greater restoration or similar. Dies if max HP reaches 0.
**Haste.** Until end of its next turn, magically gains +2 AC, advantage on DEX saves, and additional slam attack as bonus action. Recharges 5-6.
